progress_deltas.description: Upgraded q23 protocol from single recursive loop to maximum-useful-depth frontier expansion with repeated live refresh, anti-stagnation route changes and hard per-cycle progress requirements.
Current official Qwen3.5-4B evidence confirms native vision encoder and explicit vision configuration, strengthening the prior against a duplicate heavy semantic Retina encoder.

Qwen3-VL-Embedding's dedicated retrieval objective strengthens the counterclaim that raw generative VLM features may need a tiny projection/readout or dedicated light embedding baseline for calibrated familiarity/open-set behavior.
Added multimodal text-label/visual-prototype anchor hypothesis for user-specific concepts with explicit false-familiarity falsifier.
Added semantic feature-distance controller hypothesis between deterministic pixel change and full language-semantic decode.
Separated abliteration compatibility into visual-representation stability and end-to-end decoder/action competence rather than treating multimodality as one monolithic property.
Registered q23 as a discoverable domain_research branch so dynamic whole-mesh research can include it, while retaining its maximum-depth research mode.
Converted the field from a static source priority list into a source-edge network with citation/runtime/countermechanism traversal and branch saturation semantics.

invalid_progress_rule: Rephrasing, same-ancestry confirmation, source-count growth without new edges/tests, or NO_CHANGE without uncertainty reduction/alternative elimination does not count.
